title: Quest Continuation · September–October 2026
dek: Follow the quests after 7 September: the changing forest, the harpy cave, a remedy, Papirak’s funeral and the Dasa’s request for freedom.
body:
The September–October continuation follows expeditions, a funeral and a request for freedom. Dangerous places change between visits, while the living decide what they owe to the dead and to people who cannot protect themselves.

Dates below are Discord posting dates in America/New_York. They locate the source scenes; they do not establish an in-world calendar. The supplement was collected through 11 October UTC, and its latest supplied post falls on 10 October locally.

Follow the continuation

8–11 September · the tower turns hostile

Oya, Ryvyt and Pelagia encounter dark spirits whose movement differs from earlier fights. The forest route contains a path Ryvyt does not remember, withered ground and watchful shadow children. At the tower, a voice identified as Hana refuses access to what it keeps hidden. A small doll falls inert before larger hostile presences and the guardians Tik and Tok attack.

The expedition becomes a rescue. Pelagia urges retreat; Oya heals the fallen Ryvyt and carries him out. The party escapes, leaving the tower’s purpose, Hana’s nature and the relationship between the doll and the larger presence unresolved. Read Hana’s encounter record and Verdelune’s changing routes.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

18–19 September · returning to The Before

Shared dreams draw Di’trillio, Pell, Ibere and Bohlale toward The Before; Vessalia joins them without the same depth of compulsion. A moving tree reveals an entrance, and the company descends into halls and heavy haze.

Vessalia becomes contaminated and retreats with Pell when both feel ill. Di’trillio continues, later leaving foul water and returning to find his companions; Ibere removes a violet crystal while Bohlale is affected by the haze. The record demonstrates the cost of going deeper, without revealing the ruins’ protected ancient history or turning improvised coverings into reliable protection. Read the modern expeditions into The Before.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

19–27 September · the harpy cave

Di’trillio, Vessalia, Djöhandrai, Pell, Moira Eshdin and Saoirse return to the Old Earth Hills to investigate the flock’s unexplained changes. Vessalia locates the route that carries song through the rocks. Inside, a distorted corpse gives Di’trillio a contamination response that nearby violet crystals do not all share. Their color alone does not prove that every formation is Delerium.

The fight brings down Vessalia and Pell. Saoirse heals Vessalia; Moira restores Pell at a cost to her own wounds. A fallen creature leaves a ghostlike form carrying purple haze. Deeper in the chamber, an unnamed dead person’s letter describes a loved singer changed by violet corruption and their attempt to destroy the shards. This is testimony found beside the body, rather than a complete explanation of the flock.

Investigators cannot establish a single origin or direction of spread. Pell gives the dead a final prayer; Saoirse’s Petalio strikes the weakened support as the party withdraws. Saoirse takes the letter to seek an identification. The passage is collapsed, but neither the dead person’s identity nor a connection to The Before is resolved. Read the hills’ history.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.

28 September · a remedy for Bogdan

Lucien Fenlas, Pell, Vylaris Monry, Jangir and Clive L. Dragoon answer a forest herbalist’s request. Mama Tabitha needs five ingredients for a remedy for her husband Bogdan, whose illness she describes as a worse variant of Black Bile Fever. Pell’s examination confirms serious symptoms; it does not establish the cause of every similar illness in Prima.

At the graveyard grove, Kazhinju attacks after learning who sent them. Vylaris prevents an attack on her and continues talking. She says she gave Bogdan the disease because she wanted to take him with her, then breaks down and permits the harvest. Her confession concerns Bogdan; she explicitly denies knowledge of illness in Pristinia.

Kazhinju guides the gathering. Those who return receive a meal and payment from Tabitha; Pell is treated for the anaesthetic he accidentally inhaled in her home. The export ends the quest with the ingredients delivered, without separately showing Bogdan’s recovery.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

29–30 September · questions at the Petal Market

Ryvyt and Pelagia return by Emberwillow Bridge to ask local people about the forest. Time is uneven: Pelagia experiences a shorter interval than Ryvyt, and a path seen earlier is absent. These observations do not settle whether the river, music or another influence causes the changes.

The Larkhollow Petal Market supplies an ordinary center of trade: plants, tea, cloth, ribbons and trinkets. Herbalist Sylvi Fernstep claims Lady Hana’s history is older than local accounts suggest. Ilyra Bellflower discusses the travelers’ questions and warns against drinking deeply from the river. Neither statement resolves the tower.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

30 September–1 October · the work of remembrance

Papirak’s funeral already forms part of Pristinia’s civic history. The continuation confirms the burial of his staff with Fenwick’s Sequester, Melian’s rite and Scribonia’s promise to restore the Training Dungeon. These are the same event, rather than a second funeral.

It also sharpens the personal consequences. Pell finds purpose in trusted service after repeatedly doubting his usefulness on expeditions. Pappy carries the casket and calls himself the last of his and Papirak’s generation; his claim preserves his grief without independently proving an ancient chronology. Saoirse describes her intention to educate Pristinia’s young, while Bitoshi credits Papirak, Pappy and Adelia with his own early mentorship.

Felicity places Pell’s worn statue of Cala where daylight will reach it. Public remembrance becomes something tangible in the mausoleum, and something the next generation can inherit. Scribonia’s commitment remains a promise whose completion has yet to be shown.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

9–10 October · Viota’s monument

Ilyra’s letter brings Ryvyt, Fenwick, Saelihn and Trougar back to an old road and ruins near Larkhollow. They find deliberately spaced seeds, worn gathering baskets and a flower-covered woman’s monument. Fenwick reveals and activates an invisible marking; a small child figure emerges from the monument and calls the forest’s children remembrance rather than descendants.

The party refuses to attack a watching shadow child. Saelihn cleans the site while preserving its vines; Fenwick takes a rubbing for translation. Ilyra later reads the title Viota of the First Passage and words about a spring that would no longer begin. The inscription and figure’s words are evidence of the monument’s story, without establishing Viota’s full identity or cosmological role.

Read the discoveries at Viota’s monument. Ryvyt’s suggestion that a druid might help remains a proposal. The source contains a pointer to a separate Legend Lore response, but not its contents; that missing response supplies no new public facts here.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

10 October · the Dasa ask for help

Fresh graffiti honoring Swift Foot draws Di’trillio, Aurélia, Samgori, the Dark Raven and Thorn from the Pilgrim’s Hearth toward the Rahu embassy. Parchment, expensive paint and Raven’s unusual tracking sight lead them to the gardens.

Kimi and Kuri, two Dasa, ask for quiet and help obtaining freedom. Kimi says Swift lives through them and names Vey and Vaa as siblings with plans against their captivity. Di’trillio promises to find the siblings. Kuri places them roughly two days northwest of Pristinia, while admitting neither Dasa has been there. That is a reported route, not a verified map position.

Kimi reports that Hildethrax said refugees had been captured and executed; Di’trillio’s report of refugees in Eovar gives her hope. The contradiction does not independently establish the refugees’ identities or what Hildethrax knew. The scene ends before an expedition finds Vey and Vaa. Swift’s renewed presence is a legacy of resistance, not evidence of resurrection. Read the appeal and its open questions.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

What the source covers

The supplement extends the earlier main quest archive with accessible quest posts and a short Pristinia Library exchange. Inaccessible private archived threads were excluded. Attachments are linked in the export, but their contents are not supplied. The raw transcript remains outside the public site.

The accompanying update memo helps identify subjects to check; primary scenes support the published account. Read the archive’s coverage and evidence rules. Player Perspectives remains a separate reference to Story Notes, with its own source range.
